contentHtml:
Professional dish mounting, cable routing, router setup and whole-home wi-fi coverage across Stretton and Brisbane. I am an IT technician, not just an antenna installer, so the job does not stop once the dish is on the roof. I set it up for your whole home, office or larger property. Plenty of installers wash their hands of it once the gear is up. I do the whole thing.

Starlink is sold as DIY, and there is a catch

The dish needs a completely clear view of the sky, the cable has to get from the roof into the house without leaks or damage, and if something goes wrong, Starlink's only support is an online portal, which is not much help when your internet is the thing that is down.

I do not stop when the dish is on the roof

  • Site survey, finding the spot with a clear view of the sky and the best run into the house.
  • Dish mounting, fixed securely and safely, roof or pole.
  • Cable routing, run neatly and sealed so there are no leaks down the track.
  • Router and wi-fi setup, so the connection reaches every room, not just the spot nearest the dish.
  • Network integration, tied into your existing gear, mesh or cabling so it all works as one.

Starlink is a strong option where the NBN is slow or not available. If you are weighing it against a fixed connection, see my NBN setup service, and for coverage across a larger property there is mesh wi-fi and network optimisation.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
